body: I can't reproduce the crash with current master, `Input.vibrate_handheld` seems to work without issues. Tested on Pixel 8 Pro/Android 15.
@Jakub-Doucek It's a permission issue. Please make sure VIBRATE permission is enabled in export settings.

I'll create MRP and post it in the evening or tommorow.

You are right. I created a new project and tried a minimal setup and it crashes only when permission is not set. I'm pretty sure I set the permissions yesterday not sure why it didn't work. But now with permissions set, it works ok.

Documentation says this:
```
Note: For Android, vibrate_handheld() requires enabling the VIBRATE permission in the export preset. Otherwise, vibrate_handheld() will have no effect.
```

Looks like there is no crash, it just exited..

Without the vibrate permission, the app does crash. Tested on Galaxy S21 Ultra, Godot 4.4 stable, I think the best would be to detect if the permission is set, ignore the call to Input.vibrate_handheld if it's not, and add a warning to the output explaining it needs the permission to be set.
